boilerplate_E_leaf.what: one 6-word generic question wording shared by 6 easy public items and SGD (sgd_dstc8_train) Choice instructions; question text only (no state, no options, no answer); >= 5 candidate groups, so non-quarantining by rule

flagged_item.item: 1 hard public-231 item (tradeoff, Choice); flagged by the r2 rescreen through 2 G6 groups (shared topical phrases)
flagged_item.fresh_screen: DEV2.0-8B training has 2 generated a2_calendar rows sharing one sampled 30-char gram with it
flagged_item.effect: no released model trained on the flagged groups; the one DEV2 model that answers it (27B) has no overlap with it; removing it changes public totals by <= 1 item for every model (m5, 4B/9B/27B gate records)

limitations: base-model and Decision 1.0 training data are not screened (Lux 1.0 is 2/3 of the 8B soup weights; Nox/Sol/Eos start the 4B/2B/0.8B)
program generators (A2 verifiable, A7 Stage 1-4) are screened only through their emitted rows
screens are lexical; paraphrase-level reuse is not covered (embedding scans exist only for some pools)

public_minus_sealed_gap_v1_4_2.note: the gap measures the shift to the 308 fresh sealed items (untrained raw-logit controls also exceed 25 pp); it does not identify training on public items

cards.JPT-0.8B / JPT-4B / JPT-9B (kirp): Cards headline JevBench v1.4 public accuracy (JPT-4B: "highest public accuracy of any system"); training table: "Held out: no item from JevBench, EnvBench held-out seeds, the Decision Index frozen suite or our typed test split". No sealed score.
cards.Kev (jaredpalmer): Datasets metadata lists public classification sets; "On JevBench's public items, which no training or selection step saw"; reports public 231 as report-only.
cards.Decider 2B / 4B (Mapika): "No JevBench item and no Decision Index item was used for training, for writing the generators or the document questions, for selecting the checkpoint, or for the temperatures"; generators written from the family names JevBench publishes for its sealed set; public items "read once ... after the rule decisions". Cards still report version-over-version public hard-tier gains (+13 / +11 items).
cards.Intern-Decision-0.8B: Reports Jevbench-Easy / Original / Hard columns; no training-data declaration about JevBench.
cards.Hopper (G): "not tuned for JevBench; we make no claim there"; official run requested (issue #112).
cards.Eikos-27B: Evaluation suites "never used in training"; public 231 run as a setup check (48/72/93); official run requested (#117). No explicit JevBench training statement.
cards.AutoJev-27B: No JevBench mention; exact curated training corpus not bundled (SFT data from a closed model per provenance record).
cards.Jet v6.2: "Exact content/group exclusions do not establish semantic or pretraining decontamination. Benchmarks informed training focus." No JevBench mention.
cards.Nimble v2 / Jebadiah-27B / Bosun / GLiNE: No JevBench training declaration; Jebadiah reports a public 231 self-run (200/231).

panels.probe-p231-noev: public standard + hard (72 + 111 = 183 items); state replaced by a fixed placeholder ("No evidence is provided."); questions, criteria and option order unchanged
panels.probe-typed-noev: 183 typed FINAL items (seeded, stratified by family x type to match public type mix); state replaced the same way (dict states -> same keys, empty values)

not_local: Decider-2B (weights not on node A; hf download needed)

weights_node_A.DEV2.0: checkpoint paths in each formal run COLLECT.json

design.readout: per model: evidence-free accuracy on each probe panel; retention = share of full-evidence-correct items still correct without evidence; memorization index = (public noev acc - typed noev acc) minus the same difference for the unexposed DEV2 references (paired item bootstrap, 5,000 draws); flag if the lower bound > +10 pp. Suggestive only; question-only answerable items are absorbed by the reference difference.

cost.basis: prior COLLECT.json walls: public231 18-46 s per <=9B model, 94 s Eikos-27B; typed FINAL 52-129 s / 1,600 rows (288 s Eikos); probe rows are 183 + 183 with shorter inputs; + 8-item smokes

design.mechanism: same_panel collect checks every panel against the frozen registry (panels.ALL prompts_sha256), and run_same_panel.sh only mounts the gold-free panel root; a custom probe panel therefore needs a registry change (two ALL entries + gold paths) committed, pushed and mirrored. Without code change the only route is invoking each adapter module directly in the image (no collector receipts).
